title: Kernel-check XOR basis equality lifting to arbitrary bit streams
head: 153a01c5e804bc4fa45e8e6d83ec943d3d4c1325
body:
The retained semantic D contract uses the implication that equality of every Boolean basis column gives equality on arbitrary bit streams. This contribution kernel-checks that generic bridge in Lean and binds its finite premise externally to the PR589/PR1062 D prefixes.

Four Lean roots prove basis completeness, linearity of arbitrary finite XOR gate lists, pointwise stream lifting for any index type, and substitution before an unchanged continuation. A real three-wire helper-restoration example is proved with kernel `decide`; omitting restoration or a helper read makes the compiler reject the proposition. Actual Lean4.34.1 compilation and live axiom audits pass with only `propext` and `Quot.sound`.

Two separate Python engines agree on every661 dirty input column and all436,921 coefficients of the unchanged source prefixes. Their 18,085 and5,548 ADD counts remain predecessor results. Source hashes precede decompression; gate omission, wrong frame, partial-input testing, Git-free export and source/proof/typed-receipt mutations are checked. The Python3.12 registered replay and optimized direct replay pass.

The actual compressed-word translation and661-column equality remain outside Lean. This does not formally admit H2/K, implement physical streams, establish a new saving or change kappa. The README and BOUNDARY.md distinguish the generic theorem, finite application and outstanding physical obligations. Credit stays with the PR425/555/589/967/1062/1194 lineage; nearby PR590/612/878 target-translation interfaces and PR1883 typed-prefix composition address different statements.

Canonical main refreshed unchanged at `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority4. Final overlap search covered752 open PRs and1,216 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. Scope selection, remaining questions and limits are recorded in TASK.json. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review or hosted CI pass is claimed.
